you_should_know.title: Trump approves federal disaster aid for Texas counties impacted by devastating July floods
you_should_know.summary: Communities in the Texas Hill Country, the region of small towns and rivers beginning about 30 miles northwest of San Antonio, TX, hit by severe floods gain extended federal support after President Trump approved a major disaster declaration.
